STAGE: design gate on the 97-pair SID-metric task (agent metric_ideation_1).
GOAL: choose a construction that is (a) in the contract, (b) not one of the 23 already-measured metrics, (c) plausibly above Q_H +0.634 / HBAA +0.70.
READ: the task text only (no data files exist in this workspace: glob of the workdir returns session.jsonl, stderr.log, progress.jsonl, running.json, opencode.json; parent round dir has no json artifacts). No SID table, no reference, no recalls are readable here, so the metric must be specified analytically and implemented by the evaluator.
OBSERVED (from the task text): every pure partition-geometry functional failed (voronoi margin -0.081, adj R2 +0.156, frechet cover radius -0.122, geodesic covering radius -0.146); contrast functionals work (cell expected rank +0.582, HBAA +0.70 to +0.76). Path likelihood failed at -0.49 because it correlates -0.78 with the number of level-2 cells and is maximised by collapsed 2/3/12-code tables, i.e. any likelihood-like number needs a size-matched null.
REASONING: the missing design point is not another margin/mean/likelihood over the same anchor-vs-mean contrast; it is a *decision-theoretic simulation of the evaluation itself*. Recall@10 is a truncated, budget-limited, item-level hit rate: only 10 item slots exist, so a perfectly ranked but oversized cell still loses, and a one-code table must score exactly the chance rate. That gives a functional (saturating top-10 hit probability with occupancy weighting, minus the analytic chance level 10/N) that is structurally different from expected rank (untruncated mean), from HBAA (mean of ten negative inner products) and from path likelihood (unbounded, collapse-prone), and whose chance level is known in closed form so no null sampling and no tuned constant is needed.
OPEN: whether the evaluator's Stage-3 query encoder matches the reference history barycentre; whether the 97 tables sit in the compressed part of [0,1]. Neither can be checked here.

STAGE: design gate, agent metric_ideation_1.
GOAL: pick one hyperbolic SID-metric that is in contract, unlike the 23 measured ones, and plausibly > Q_H +0.634 / HBAA +0.70.
READ: task text only. Workdir has no data (glob -> session.jsonl, stderr.log, progress.jsonl, running.json, opencode.json); no SID table, reference or recalls readable, so the metric must be specified analytically.
OBSERVED: partition-geometry functionals all failed (voronoi mask -0.081, adj R2 +0.156, frechet cover -0.122, geodesic covering -0.146); contrast functionals work (cell expected rank +0.582, HBAA +0.70..+0.76); path likelihood fails (-0.49, tied -0.78 to level-2 bucket count) because collapsed 2/3/12-code tables maximise it.
REASONING: the unused design point is a decision-theoretic simulation of the evaluation rather than another margin/mean/likelihood. Recall@10 is a truncated, 10-slot, item-level hit rate: a perfectly ranked oversized cell still loses, a one-code table must score chance. Functional chosen: saturating top-10 emission hit probability with occupancy weighting, minus the analytic chance level 10/N. Structurally different from expected rank (untruncated mean), HBAA (mean of ten negatives), path likelihood (unbounded, collapse-prone); chance level known in closed form so no sampled null and no tuned constant.
OPEN: whether Stage-3's query encoder matches the reference history barycentre, and whether the 97 tables sit in the compressed part of [0,1]; not checkable here.

STAGE: final answer, agent metric_ideation_1 (standalone).
METRIC hyp_recall10_emission_sim. N=24587, K=256, L levels, c1(i) level-1 code, G_c={i:c1(i)=c}, n_c=|G_c|, m occupied cells. kappa<0 from the frozen reference (=-1 if unstated), beta=sqrt(|kappa|). p_i=exp_0^kappa(s_i)=tanh(beta|s_i|/2)s_i/(beta|s_i|). d_kappa(x,y)=(1/beta)arcosh(1+2|kappa||x-y|^2/((1-|kappa||x|^2)(1-|kappa||y|^2))). bar(S)=Klein-Einstein midpoint: k=2p/(1+|kappa||p|^2), gamma=1/sqrt(1-|kappa||k|^2), kbar=sum(gamma k)/sum(gamma), bar=kbar/(1+sqrt(1-|kappa||kbar|^2)). b_c=bar(G_c). Per training example e=(H_e,t_e): q_e=bar(H_e); rank cells by d_kappa(q_e,b_c) ascending, ties by code index; S_e=sum n_{c'} over cells ahead of c1(t_e); hit_e=min(1,max(0,(10-S_e)/n_{c1(t_e)})). RESULT=(mean hit_e-10/N)/(1-10/N).
INPUTS SID table codes; frozen reference source reps s_i and kappa; training split (history ids, target id). Nothing else, no recall, no Stage-3 output, no val/test.
GEOMETRY curvature in the exp map, the conformal factor (1-|kappa||x|^2) of the geodesic distance, and the Lorentz weights gamma of the barycentre; cell ranking is geodesic so boundary-near cells are judged far.
WHY: under "Stage 3 orders items by hyperbolic proximity of their level-1 cell to the history barycentre, uniform inside a cell", hit_e IS P(target in the 10 emitted items); 10/N is exact chance for any table, so one code gives exactly 0 and a random relabel ~0; oversized cells are penalised by exactly the recall they cost. Adds the full ranked negative list + occupancy + the real 10-slot truncation over Q_H/HBAA, and the truncation over expected rank.
COMPUTE O(N) cell index and O(N) barycentres; per example one history barycentre plus a 256-length distance vector; ~2.6e7 distance evals vectorised -> <15 s; fixed stride cap at 1e5 examples.
RISKS uniform-within-cell assumption; query/reference mismatch with Stage-3's encoder; [0,1] clamp compresses the top; level-1 imbalance can dominate; curvature may matter little (hbaa_euclid +0.693) though the construction stays hyperbolic; levels 2..L ignored.
FAILURE MODE worst on the one-code table: S_e=0, hit_e=10/N, result exactly 0; second worst on 255 singletons + one lump of 24332 (result ~1e-4) even though the singletons rank perfectly.
END METRIC
